affiliations.date_precision: The official enlistment record carries civilian occupation code 316 at Army entry on 16 October 1941. NARA's corrected Code No. 30 list defines 3-16 as farm hands on general farms and names no employer.
affiliations.research_notes: Corrects the former secondary automobile-serviceman interpretation. The exact private-identifier match confirms the record; the official corrected code list supports only general-farm work, and no employer is inferred.

claims.claim_text: At Army entry in October 1941, Johnnie Batten's civilian occupation code represented general-farm hand work.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact-matched enlistment row carries code 316; NARA's corrected official list defines it as general-farm hand work and names no employer.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The exact private-identifier match confirms that the enlistment row belongs to the indexed person.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded to Army entry on 16 October 1941, but not proven to be his final civilian role before OSS.
claims.match_notes: This claim supersedes the Batch 161 secondary automobile-serviceman decoding, which conflicted with NARA's corrected Code No. 30. No employer is inferred.

person_updates.next_action: Review Box 42 and identifier-linked Army records to identify the employer behind general-farm occupation code 316 and establish the path from Army entry to OSS.

research_attempts.query_text: Johnnie Batten; exact private identifier; Army civilian occupation code 316; NARA corrected Code No. 30; conflicting secondary code table
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: The older secondary occupation-code transcription maps 316 to automobile serviceman but conflicts with NARA's corrected Code No. 30 and was rejected.
research_attempts.research_notes: A cross-batch consistency review found incompatible published meanings for code 316. NARA's official corrected documentation supports general-farm hand work; the prior secondary decoding was superseded. No authenticated NARA Catalog API request was made.
research_attempts.next_action: Review Box 42 and original Army records for the employer and transition to OSS.
